name: Jasper
bestFor: On-brand marketing copy and content produced at scale across a whole team
description: An AI content platform purpose-built for marketing teams, with brand voice controls, workflow agents, and a canvas for producing campaigns, ads, and long-form content on-brand.

freeTier.limits: 7-day free trial on the Pro plan only, no persistent free tier

paidTier.notes: Pro is $69/seat/month ($59/mo billed annually). Business is custom-priced with a 12-month minimum commitment, adding a custom agent builder and SSO.

name: Copy.ai
bestFor: Workflow-driven AI copywriting and go-to-market content automation
description: An AI workflow platform for marketing and GTM content — from chat-based copywriting up to multi-step automated content and outreach workflows with credit-based scaling.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; Chat plan is the entry-level paid option

paidTier.notes: Chat is $29/mo (5 seats). Growth/Expansion/Scale plans run $1,000–$3,000/month billed annually for larger teams and workflow credit pools. Enterprise is custom.

name: HubSpot Marketing Hub (Breeze AI)
bestFor: Teams that want AI content, campaigns, and lead scoring built into their CRM/marketing platform
description: HubSpot's marketing suite with Breeze, its native AI assistant and agents, generating content, forms, and campaign insights directly inside the CRM data marketing teams already use.

freeTier.limits: Free plan for up to 2 users, 1,000 marketing contacts

paidTier.notes: Starter from $7/seat/month. Professional from $800/month (3 seats incl.) plus a $3,000 onboarding fee. Enterprise from $3,600/month (5 seats) plus a $7,000 onboarding fee. AI features run on a shared HubSpot Credits pool.

name: Surfer SEO
bestFor: AI-assisted SEO content optimization and tracking visibility inside AI search results
description: An SEO content platform that scores and optimizes drafts against top-ranking pages, and now tracks brand visibility inside ChatGPT, Gemini, and AI Overviews as AI search grows.

freeTier.limits: Free trial available; no persistent free plan

paidTier.notes: Discovery is $49/mo; Standard $99/mo; Pro $182/mo; Peace of Mind (unlimited) $299/mo; a separate AI Search Analytics add-on is $82/mo. Enterprise is custom.

name: Synthesia
bestFor: Turning scripts into professional AI-avatar video for training, ads, and campaigns without a camera crew
description: An AI video generation platform that turns text scripts into presenter-led videos using realistic AI avatars and voices, used for marketing, training, and internal comms video at scale.

freeTier.limits: 1,200 credits/month, ~10 minutes of video, 9 AI avatars

paidTier.notes: Starter is $29/mo ($18/mo billed annually); Creator $89/mo ($64/mo annually). Enterprise is custom with unlimited minutes and SSO.

name: Canva (Magic Studio)
bestFor: Fast, on-brand marketing design and creative production for non-designers
description: Canva's AI suite (Magic Studio) generates and edits designs, images, and brand-consistent creative assets directly inside the design tool most marketing teams already use.

freeTier.limits: Free plan with core design tools and limited Magic Studio AI credits

paidTier.notes: Pro is $18/month (~$12/mo billed annually) with full Magic Studio access. Business (formerly Teams) is roughly $25/user/month. Enterprise is custom.
